criteria.text: Production app and worker use the owner-approved active Treejar Trading Wazzup channel, with a protected rollback copy of the prior environment.
Only app and worker are recreated; public health reports the unchanged release SHA with healthy Redis and PostgreSQL, and container restart and OOM state remain green.
A fresh tester message from the active channel is accepted into the normal queue and reply path; previously dropped messages are neither replayed nor manually answered.
